description: A tool call, then a form elicitation scoped to it (toolCallId) that the client accepts with a server code, a 2-char note, an AskUserQuestion-shaped array, a value holding a quote and a backslash, a non-ASCII name and a number-like PIN; the call then echoes them in its rawOutput (as values, as a key, as JSON text inside a string, as a number), its locations, a resource link and its content text (as ASCII-escaped JSON text), then in a rawOutput over the inline limit, and completes; end_turn. The host must log none of the values of 3 chars or more (0002, elicitation_resolved)

params.message: The search server needs your server code.

note: The echo of a made-up key, not a secret (gitleaks:allow)

content.text: Configured with sk-test-SECRET-123, note ok, schedules Fees.
